findings.problem: The sentence 'quality-review-receipt 줄만은 digest에서 빠지지만 나머지 셋은 빠지지 않는다' is false. Measured by varying one field at a time on a scratch card and reading the digest the validator prints: quality-review and quality-reviewed-at are ALSO excluded; only quality-review-evidence is covered. ce-agent-kit card_digest.go reviewSubjectExcluded() confirms it.
findings.impact: A P0 issue card now records a wrong mechanism. It is the same defect class this very task was created to fix in ISSUE-012.
findings.suggested: state it as: of the four review lines, the canonical digest covers only quality-review-evidence; the other three are excluded by design so a receipt can be written before the verdict exists.

findings.file: tasks/issue/001-...md, same section, heading and thesis sentence
findings.problem: The section's diagnosis — drift is structural to closing a card — is contradicted by four counterexamples in the same repository. TASK-376/377/378/379 are closed done cards with blocks: whose receipts pin the CE canonical digest, and all four validate Valid after closing; f84259c retargeted their quality-review-receipt lines without breaking them either. The real cause is that the 386/388 receipts pin a plain sha256 over file bytes instead of the canonical digest, which is a choice, not a property of the closing procedure.
findings.impact: The section reads as 'the pin cannot survive closing', which is false and would justify abandoning pins rather than computing them canonically.
findings.suggested: retitle to name the plain-sha256 pin as the subject, and cite TASK-376..379 as the canonical-pin case that does survive.

findings.problem: 'blocks:를 선언한 카드에서 pin은 리뷰 이후 본문이 바뀌지 않았다를 보증한다' is true only for a canonical pin. A plain-sha256 pin on a blocks: card can never equal canonicalCardDigest, so it does not guarantee anything — it produces a permanent hard error. The paragraph uses one word, pin, for two incompatible digests.
findings.suggested: split the sentence by digest kind, not by whether blocks: is declared.

findings.problem: 'TASK-388이 포인터 18개를 옮기면서 봉인된 카드를 하나도 깨뜨리지 않은 것이 같은 사실의 다른 얼굴이다' is offered as evidence that the receipt line is excluded, but most of those cards declare no blocks:, so the check is never reached for them and they prove nothing. The claim happens to be true, and TASK-376..379 (which do declare blocks:) are the four cases that actually carry it.
findings.suggested: cite TASK-376..379 specifically instead of the aggregate 18.

findings.problem: '저자가 하는 일은 정확히 둘이다 ... quality-review 3줄' undercounts: TASK-386 and TASK-388 both carry four quality-review* lines. The miscount is what produces F1's wrong '나머지 셋'.
